**ghz4.** Over 240 daily snapshots of real ibm_fez calibration data, a perfect tracker would have gained 0.0 % over the best fixed setting for ghz4 (arm 5, Z-R); the best setting changed significantly 4 times (5 epochs, median length 6 days; 10 raw argmax flips, ambiguous-day fraction 0.39). eps-greedy had the lowest dynamic pseudo-regret, 2.39 [1.92, 2.95], against 5.27 for the everything-on default and 1.00 for the static oracle (seeds 10–10).

**Proxy validation (per day).** ghz4: the mirror score picked the forward-best arm on 46 % of 240 days (median Spearman 0.88, median forward regret of the mirror pick 1 % of the worst arm's). grover3: the mirror score picked the forward-best arm on 94 % of 240 days (median Spearman 0.93, median forward regret of the mirror pick 0 % of the worst arm's). qft3: the mirror score picked the forward-best arm on 29 % of 240 days (median Spearman 0.62, median forward regret of the mirror pick 8 % of the worst arm's).

**Drivers.** ghz4: a multinomial logistic fit of the best arm on chain cz error, readout error, T1 and T2 reaches cross-validated accuracy 0.98 against a majority rate of 0.98; 3 of 4 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51). ghz8: a multinomial logistic fit of the best arm on chain cz error, readout error, T1 and T2 reaches cross-validated accuracy nan against a majority rate of 1.00; 0 of 1 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51). grover3: a multinomial logistic fit of the best arm on chain cz error, readout error, T1 and T2 reaches cross-validated accuracy 0.97 against a majority rate of 0.99; 2 of 3 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51). qaoa6: 0 of 0 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51). qft3: a multinomial logistic fit of the best arm on chain cz error, readout error, T1 and T2 reaches cross-validated accuracy 0.99 against a majority rate of 0.99; 1 of 2 significant switches fall within a day of a chip-wide recalibration (base rate 0.51).
